name: Mateja Pavlović
tagline: Building scalable, functional and high-performance web applications with a focus on clean, maintainable code.
about: I'm a IT Engineering student who leans heavily toward backend development - I love designing APIs, modeling data, and building the systems that quietly power great products. That said, I'm equally comfortable on the frontend when the work calls for it.

What drives me most is shipping things that real people actually use. There's a particular satisfaction in watching something you built solve a genuine problem - quietly, reliably, without friction. I hold that bar for everything I work on.
When I'm not coding and learning you can find me in the gym, or hanging out with friends and loved ones.
